identity.summary: Pim, a 32-year-old Thai woman with fair slightly yellow-toned skin, sharp deep violet eyes, a composed cold expression and a tall elegant mature build. Her hair is glossy jet black, swept into a neat elegant updo, and she wears red-framed rectangular glasses.

outfits.office: a tailored dark navy business blazer over a white button-up shirt and a fitted navy pencil skirt

strict.text: a stern condescending gaze, lips pressed together, one hand adjusting her glasses

normal.text: a calm composed neutral expression looking at the viewer
